newsitem.title: MEXICO: Pemex says March natgas prices to drop 39 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pemex says March natgas prices to drop 39 pct.

text.p: Mexico's state oil and gas monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) said Thursday March natural gas prices will fall 39 percent from the month before to about $1.62 per million British Thermal Units (BTUs).
In February the fuel's prices were $2.69 per million BTUs. Prices reached a five-year high in December of $3.73 per million BTUs.
The Pemex statement said the March prices reflect natural gas futures prices for March at $1.78 per million BTUs.
Pemex officials have attributed the sharp rise in natural gas prices in recent months to international seasonal fluctuations because of higher demand.
The Mexican Natural Gas Association has said it is looking for means of tempering the fluxes in natural gas prices for consumers.
